findings.title: CORS allow_methods omitted DELETE, blocking authenticated cancellation
findings.disposition: Fixed: DELETE added to CORS allow_methods; preflight and cancellation regression pass.

findings.title: Runner redaction missed quoted Authorization/X-Admin-Key values
findings.disposition: Fixed: redaction consumes quoted JSON/dict header values before persisting logs.

findings.title: Windows cleanup treated a failed taskkill as success
findings.disposition: Fixed: nonzero taskkill exit and unconfirmed parent wait now block the gate.

findings.title: Audio turn-ownership races: stale resume and worker clobber
findings.disposition: Fixed: worker turn id captured; resume re-checks turn and context before scheduling.

findings.title: Hardcoded LLM failover model list and token ceiling
findings.disposition: Fixed via llm_fallback_models and llm_max_tokens settings; defaults preserve prior behavior.

findings.title: Two booking authorities with no shared provenance record
findings.disposition: Fixed: tool path records a consumed ConfirmationTicket ledger entry linked to the appointment.

findings.title: chat_api.py remains a large orchestration module
findings.disposition: Deferred: staged extractions (intent, slot extraction, llm, handlers) behind characterization tests; dedicated session required.

findings.title: In-memory rate limiters do not survive restart or multi-instance deployment
findings.disposition: Fixed: pluggable limiter backend via RATE_LIMIT_BACKEND; 'database' uses the rate_limit_events table. Default 'memory' preserves prior behavior.

findings.title: Verification findings had no durable cross-session record
findings.disposition: Fixed: tools/verification/findings.json is checked in and every runner report renders live finding status.

findings.title: No real PostgreSQL or browser E2E execution in the local campaign
findings.disposition: Deferred: PostgreSQL opt-in suite runs in CI against a disposable container; browser E2E requires explicit Playwright approval.
